# DataFlowAnalysis

This repository contains an analysis to extract dataflows from a palladio modeling project, analyze their data characteristics and formulate constraints to check if definied bounds are respected by the model. For more information visit the [official page] https://dataflowanalysis.org/ of the project.

## Installation

Install the product from our [updatesite] https://updatesite.palladio-simulator.com/DataFlowAnalysis/product/nightly/

Clone this repository

Import the projects in this repository
